component.name: EasySearch
component.summary: Instant file and content search across your filesystem

description.p: EasySearch searches file names and file contents as you type, across your whole filesystem, and keeps its index up to date in realtime as files are created, renamed, changed and deleted.
It is a lightweight native desktop application: no database, no runtime, no web view.

ul.li: Realtime index kept fresh by kernel filesystem events (inotify)
Everything-style queries: globs, multiple terms, exclusion, regex
Content search powered by the embedded ripgrep engine, always current
Live preview pane, tabs, search history and quick location filters
Follows your desktop's light/dark theme and fonts
Optional tray icon, plus a scriptable CLI
